papers.title_en: Beyond the Trial-and-Error Loop: Hybrid Projection and Automated Tuning for Distributed Training
papers.authors: Anshu Raina, Peyman Razaghi, Yuankai Chen, Cheng Yao, Yao Fu, Vidushi Goyal, Devang Patel, Wen Xie, Zhenyu Gu, Emad Barsoum
papers.evidence: 面向多并行大模型训练的自动配置与性能预测
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式大模型训练需联合配置多维并行、批大小、重计算与通信重叠，传统多节点试错成本高且易因显存误差失败。Primus Projection结合单卡微基准、子节点缩放测量与解析仿真，快速预测目标集群吞吐和显存可行性。其调优代理以投影为评分器，通过确定性种子规划、LLM组合探索和显存预筛选搜索配置。在多种模型与GPU代际上预测误差约10%以内，并在Mixtral案例中30分钟找到较基线快27%的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Configuring distributed LLM training across hundreds of GPUs requires jointly optimizing tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism alongside micro-batch size, recomputation, sharding, and overlap, a combinatorial space where memory legality can hinge on a single byte of activation accounting. Today, teams navigate it through expensive multi-node trial and error, burning GPU-hours on crashes and suboptimal recipes. We present Primus Projection, which closes this loop with two coupled components. First, a hybrid projection engine that measures what it can and simulates what it cannot: GPU microbenchmarks on as few as a single device capture compute kernels and any in-scope communication; a sub-node downscale-measure-upscale workflow analytically restores out-of-scope collectives, FSDP overlap, and the full pipeline schedule at the multi-node target. A pure simulation mode runs entirely on CPU, enabling pre-silicon planning without any GPU. Second, the Primus Tuning Agent treats the projection engine as a fast scoring oracle (seconds per candidate instead of tens of minutes) and uses it to drive an intelligent search over the configuration space. A deterministic seed planner sweeps single axes; an LLM investigation loop proposes cross-axis combinations the planner cannot reach, with an analytic memory pre-filter that rejects infeasible candidates before any GPU time is spent. Validated on Llama 3.1 (dense) and Mixtral 8x22B (MoE) across two GPU generations, all projections stay within ~10% of measured multi-node throughput, and fidelity holds at production scale: 4.7% error on DeepSeek V3 671B at 1,024 GPUs and 1.9% on Qwen3-235B-A22B at 256 GPUs. In a Mixtral 8x22B case study, the Primus Tuning Agent discovers a configuration delivering +27% throughput over the published 4-node BF16 reference at the same scale, in under 30 minutes of single-node exploration.

papers.title_en: Eunoia: Toward Application-Transparent, Scalable GPU Sharing in AI-RAN
papers.authors: Zongshen Wu, Marko Milenković, Jiarong Xing, Rahman Doost-Mohammady
papers.evidence: 面向共置工作负载的可扩展实时GPU调度与共享
papers.tldr: AI-RAN将AI与无线接入网任务共置于同一商用GPU，但通用AI计算会争抢资源，威胁对时延极敏感的RAN处理。Eunoia提出面向实时场景、以RAN时隙为粒度的动态GPU调度，并对AI应用和RAN工作负载透明。原型部署于NVIDIA Aerial AI-RAN，在空口5G专网及多小区仿真中验证。27小区场景下，其将RAN上行P99时延控制在3毫秒以内，同时取得优于安全静态分区方案的AI性能。
papers.abstract_en: The AI-RAN paradigm makes the next-generation cellular network more versatile by co-locating AI and RAN workloads on the same commodity hardware. While the GPU is a promising platform for AI-RAN realization, a generic concurrent AI application interferes with the latency-sensitive RAN on GPU compute resources. In this paper, we propose Eunoia, a dynamic real-time AI-RAN GPU scheduler that is transparent to both AI applications and the RAN workload and operates at the granularity level of the RAN slot. We deploy Eunoia onto NVIDIA Aerial AI-RAN and evaluate Eunoia on both an over-the-air 5G private network and an emulated multi-cell network. We demonstrate that in a 27-cell AI-RAN, Eunoia keeps the RAN uplink P99 latency under 3 ms while delivering higher AI performance than other RAN-safe static partitioning methods.

papers.title_en: Stable Token-level Scheduling for Serverless LLM Inference
papers.authors: Hardi Ashishbhai Desai, Balaji N K, Sourav Kanti Addya
papers.evidence: 面向无服务器LLM推理的闭环GPU调度
papers.tldr: 无服务器大模型推理虽可弹性扩缩与共享GPU，但现有调度多只优化首词延迟，忽视生成阶段的词间延迟；新请求的预填充会干扰带宽受限的持续解码，造成延迟尖峰。论文提出令牌窗口节拍机制，以词间延迟、队列深度和负载反馈闭环控制逐令牌准入，并结合分块预填充降低干扰。实验显示，其吞吐较ServerlessLLM最高提升45%，较传统调度器提升58%，同时稳定首词延迟并改善尾延迟与生成流畅性，为无需改模的高质量服务提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Serverless inference is emerging as an efficient deployment model for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its ability to elastically scale resources, improve GPU utilization through resource sharing, and reduce infrastructure costs. However, existing approaches primarily optimize time to first token (TTFT) while overlooking inter-token latency (ITL), a key determinant of user experience during response generation. We observe that LLM inference comprises a computation-intensive prefill stage and a bandwidth-bound decode stage, where admitting new requests can disrupt ongoing decoding and increase latency. To address this, we propose Token Window Pacing (TWP), a closed-loop scheduling framework that leverages runtime feedback from ITL, queue depth, and workload characteristics to regulate request admission at the token level instead of the batch level. TWP dynamically adjusts a selfregulating token window and incorporates chunk-based prefill to minimize interference from incoming requests. Experiments on realistic serverless workloads show that TWP delivers stable TTFT, significantly reduces latency spikes, lowers P99 tail latency, minimizes ITL variation, and improves throughput by up to 45% over ServerlessLLM and 58% over conventional schedulers. These results demonstrate that feedback-driven tokenlevel scheduling enables stable, high-throughput serverless LLM inference without modifying the underlying model.

papers.title_en: Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism: Throughput-Latency Trade-off
papers.evidence: 面向分布式LLM服务的流水线与张量并行
papers.tldr: 大模型推理需在首词延迟、生成间隔与集群吞吐之间权衡，而预填充和解码对并行方式的偏好不同。论文系统刻画张量并行、流水线并行及混合配置的可行集与帕累托前沿，并以良吞吐建模SLO约束下的选择。结果显示，负载越偏预填充越应转向流水线并行；长上下文下其扩展性和SLO达成更具优势。该框架为按工作负载和时延目标配置分布式推理并行策略提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems must balance latency and throughput while efficiently utilizing distributed GPU resources. This challenge arises because inference consists of two fundamentally different phases: prefill, which determines time-to-first-token (TTFT), and decode, which determines inter-token latency (ITL). The use of tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), and hybrid configurations exposes different trade-offs between these latency dimensions, making the optimal parallelism configuration highly dependent on workload characteristics, latency requirements, and context length. Moreover, despite the widespread adoption of distributed inference, there is still limited understanding of how parallelism configurations should be selected under varying workload conditions and service-level objectives (SLO). In this paper, we develop a systematic framework for characterizing LLM inference parallelism via throughput-latency trade-offs, SLO-aware serving, and long-context scalability. We introduce the notion of parallelism operating regions by constructing TTFT-ITL feasible sets and Pareto frontiers across different workload compositions, thereby revealing a systematic transition from TP-dominant to PP-dominant configurations as workloads become increasingly prefill-heavy. We further formulate SLO-aware parallelism selection using goodput, showing that stringent TTFT requirements favor PP-dominated configurations, whereas relaxed latency constraints progressively shift the optimality toward TP-dominated configurations with higher serving capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that increasing context length fundamentally changes the relative advantages of parallelism configurations, with PP-dominant configurations exhibiting more favorable scalability and SLO attainment in the long-context regime.

papers.title_en: Energy-Aware Agentic Orchestration for Multi-Site Service Deployment
papers.authors: Rodrigo Moreira, Alisson Chaves, Larissa F. Rodrigues Moreira, Tereza Carvalho, Tiago Barros, Daniel Corujo, Rui Aguiar, David Gomez-Barquero, Flávio de Oliveira Silva
papers.evidence: 面向地理分布式AI服务基础设施的能耗感知编排
papers.tldr: 随着人工智能工作负载推动数据中心能耗上升，跨地域编排的可持续性评估不应忽略大语言模型自身的推理能耗。论文在两个欧洲数据中心的多站点 Kubernetes 测试床上，对比单次工具调用、ReAct 与规划—执行三类智能体策略。ReAct 和规划—执行可处理全部十类自然语言意图，但多轮推理显著增加图形处理器能耗；前缀缓存使 ReAct 平均能耗降低29.4%。研究表明，轻量任务带来的短时基础设施节能不足以抵消决策能耗，因而应按能耗预算选择推理策略。
papers.abstract_en: Energy-aware orchestration across geographically distributed infrastructures is increasingly important as data centers absorb growing Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads. However, existing approaches often exclude the energy cost of automated decision-making from system-level sustainability assessments. This paper presents an energy-aware agentic orchestration framework that treats Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning as a measurable component of the control loop. We compare single-shot tool calling, ReAct, and plan-and-execute strategies on a multi-site Kubernetes testbed spanning two European data centers and instrumented at layers ranging from power distribution units to per-pod energy attribution. Using ten natural-language orchestration intents with varying decision complexity, we show that reasoning strategy and intent complexity strongly influence graphics processing unit (GPU) energy consumption during orchestration decisions. ReAct and plan-and-execute generated executable tool calls across all evaluated intents but required multiple LLM inferences, whereas the single-shot configuration was less costly but non-actionable. Prefix caching reduced mean ReAct GPU energy consumption by 29.4%. For the evaluated lightweight workload, the infrastructure-energy changes observed within the one-second measurement window were insufficient to offset the measured GPU decision energy. These findings demonstrate the importance of accounting for reasoning overhead when assessing the sustainability of AI-native orchestration and motivate energy-budgeted selection of agent strategies.

papers.title_en: A New Lens on Multi-GPU Communication: API-Level Memory Models for Portable Optimization
papers.authors: Johnathan Alsop, Bradford Beckmann, Brandon Potter, Jiakun Yan, Aurelien Bouteiller, Omri Mor, Tony Tye, Sameer Sahasrabuddhe
papers.evidence: 面向机器学习负载的多GPU通信与可移植优化
papers.tldr: 多GPU机器学习与高性能计算中，网络传输逐渐成为瓶颈，而设备端单边通信API缺少严格内存模型，导致优化易出错且难以移植。论文提出面向设备通信API的抽象层内存模型，并在开源rocSHMEM中实现。通过对模型进行形式化放松，安全支持网络数据绕过缓存等优化。实验显示，集合通信、计算通信融合及专家并行负载最高分别提速2.48倍、1.77倍和1.18倍，为可移植高性能通信建立了标准化语义基础。
papers.abstract_en: As network communication increasingly becomes a performance bottleneck for ML and HPC workloads, it is more important than ever to optimize multi-GPU data transfers. Recently, low-level device APIs have emerged that allow programmers to perform fine-grain optimizations via one-sided put/get operations triggered directly from the device. However, the communication libraries providing these device APIs (e.g., rocSHMEM, MSCCL++, and NCCL/RCCL GIN) currently lack a rigorous memory model defining how their primitives interact with the underlying memory systems. Without this, emerging HPC and ML workloads aggressively optimizing network communication via device APIs can be brittle, error-prone, and face compatibility and inter-operability challenges.   This paper proposes the use of API-level memory models for these emerging device communication APIs. An API-level memory model defines the memory semantics of communication API calls in a way that abstracts lower-level details from the API user and simplifies development. This work defines one such model for device-side communication (implemented in AMD's recently open sourced rocSHMEM library) and demonstrates how formal relaxations to such a model can enable low-level LLM performance optimizations while retaining a well-defined standardized interface. Specifically, we describe how updating the SHMEM API implemented by rocSHMEM can properly support cache bypassing for network data, improving performance of a collective communication workload by up to 2.48x, a fused compute+communication workload by up to 1.77x, and a state-of-the-art expert-parallel communication workload by up to 1.18x.

papers.title_en: MODAIC: Coordinated Asynchrony for Decentralized Multimodal Learning
papers.authors: Yanhang Shi, Xiaoyu Wang, Houwei Cao, Jian Li, Yong Liu
papers.evidence: 面向异构带宽约束的异步去中心化训练
papers.tldr: 多模态去中心化学习中，设备的模态组合、算力与带宽各异，多模态节点易因通信拥塞错过聚合窗口，导致更新陈旧并拉低最弱节点精度。MODAIC通过模态解耦的分层异步、负载感知更新获取和共识感知选邻，协调本地跨模态交互与点对点更新交换。其在AVE与KU-HAR上提升平均精度及多模态最弱节点表现；AVE带宽为200 Mbps时，1000秒最弱节点精度较最强基线高11个百分点。该工作证明了无需全局等待的协同异步机制可改善异构边缘多模态训练效率与公平性。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal decentralized learning enables collaboration across heterogeneous edge devices without sharing raw data, but differing modality sets create coupled computation and communication bottlenecks. Multimodal agents support cross-modal alignment while training more model components and sharing bandwidth across multiple modality overlays. Under bandwidth limits, these agents can become hot spots: transfers miss aggregation windows, and their updates become stale or underrepresented, degrading worst-agent accuracy. Asynchrony removes global blocking but does not by itself coordinate local cross-modal interaction with timely peer-update exchange. We present MODAIC (Modality-Decoupled Asynchrony with Interleaved Coordination), a wait-free system that coordinates local modality progress, peer-to-peer update delivery, and aggregation under heterogeneous compute and bandwidth. Hierarchical asynchrony lets modalities progress independently while enforcing reciprocal feature exchange; load-aware update fetching overlaps training with communication, limits concurrent serving load, and reuses late arrivals; and consensus-aware peer selection uses lightweight metadata to account for update availability, peer participation, and loss similarity without active probing. We implement MODAIC as a containerized multi-agent framework and evaluate it on local and cross-region cloud testbeds. Across AVE and KU-HAR, MODAIC improves average accuracy and multimodal worst-agent performance. On AVE at 200 Mbps per agent, it improves multimodal worst-agent accuracy by 11.0 percentage points at 1000 seconds over the strongest baseline. On the cloud testbed, it reduces time-to-accuracy by up to 30%. Ablations show that simpler load-balancing and delayed-aggregation variants leave a worst-agent accuracy gap, and stress tests show tolerance to WAN variability and partial tracker unavailability.

papers.title_en: Decentralized collaborative continual learning: A multi-objective minimization-based technique
papers.authors: Yara Zgheib, Marc Antonini, Roula Nassif
papers.evidence: 去中心化分布式学习算法
papers.tldr: 面向数据流式到达、节点仅能与邻居通信的去中心化持续学习，本文聚焦新任务适应与旧知识遗忘之间的稳定—可塑性矛盾。方法将当前任务与各节点缓存的历史样本统一为多目标优化问题，并通过邻域协作更新参数。均方误差分析表明，协作可利用本地数据和记忆缓冲区的多样性，降低跨任务平均均方偏差。该工作为无中心协调器的持续学习提供了可分析的理论框架与算法依据。
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we formulate decentralized continual learning within a multi-objective optimization framework. For a given inference task t (corresponding to a common minimizer shared by the cost functions of all agents), agents collecting data in a distributed and streamed manner are only allowed to perform local computations and to exchange information with neighboring agents over the underlying communication graph. As tasks evolve sequentially over time, agents must adapt to newly arriving tasks while retaining knowledge acquired from previously learned ones. This requirement leads to the wellknown stability plasticity dilemma, where stability refers to the ability to retain previous knowledge, while plasticity refers to the ability to learn and adapt to new tasks. To address the stability challenge, agents store subsets of samples from past tasks in local memory buffers. Then, through an appropriate multiobjective formulation, the stored information is incorporated into the learning process so that parameter updates account jointly for the current task and previously learned tasks. The proposed decentralized continual learning approach is analyzed in the mean square error sense under general assumptions on the individual cost functions and gradient noise processes. The analysis reveals that cooperation among agents improves the performance of continual learning. In particular, by exchanging information with neighboring agents, decentralized collaborative learning can exploit the diversity of locally observed data and memory buffers to improve the network average mean-square deviation (MSD) across tasks. Finally, simulations illustrate the theoretical findings and the effectiveness of the method in reducing forgetting and improving the average MSD across tasks.

papers.title_en: Best of Both Worlds in Federated LSA: Speedup When Possible, Personalization Always
papers.authors: Safwan Labbi, Paul Mangold, Eric Moulines
papers.evidence: 适应异质性的联邦分布式优化算法
papers.tldr: 面向个性化联邦线性随机逼近，各智能体需在问题异质时求解各自线性不动点，而低异质时又希望利用协作获得随智能体数增长的加速。论文提出PF-LSA，将本地随机更新与跨智能体平均更新混合，无需预知异质性且不增加相对标准联邦方法的计算成本。理论上，它始终收敛到每个智能体的个性化解，并在学习问题足够相似时实现线性加速。其通过共识与分歧误差的精细分解统一解释两种收益，为个性化时序差分学习等场景提供自适应方案。
papers.abstract_en: We study personalized federated linear stochastic approximation (LSA), a framework which notably encompass personalized temporal difference learning. In this setting, heterogeneous agents collaborate to solve distinct linear fixed-point equations, each corresponding to an agent-specific learning problem. A central open question in personalized learning is whether a single method can adapt to an unknown level of heterogeneity by converging to each agent's personalized solution in all regimes while achieving a linear speedup in the number of agents when their learning problems are sufficiently similar. We answer this question affirmatively by introducing PF-LSA, a minimalist algorithm that mixes each agent's local stochastic update with the average update across agents, at no additional computational cost relative to standard federated methods. We prove that PF-LSA, achieves best-of-both-worlds guarantees without any prior knowledge on the level of heterogeneity. Our analysis is based on a sharp decomposition of the error into consensus and disagreement components. The consensus error decays rapidly, whereas the disagreement error decays more slowly but becomes negligible in low-heterogeneity regimes.

papers.title_en: BLEND: Balancing Personalization vs. Generalization in Federated Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Payam Abdisarabshali, Fardis Nadimi, Kasra Borazjani, Naji Khosravan, Richeng Jin, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言模型的联邦微调与聚合框架
papers.tldr: 联邦视觉语言模型在客户端数据异质条件下，常面临个性化适配与跨客户端泛化难以兼顾的问题。BLEND将可共享的视觉/文本适配器与客户端私有视觉投影适配器结合，并选择性微调和聚合参数。其损失函数融合全局与个性化输出，并以零样本VLM投影头构造锚点约束。多种系统设置实验显示，该方法持续优于现有基线，为FedVLM提供了兼顾本地性能和全局迁移能力的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Federated vision-language models (FedVLMs) represent one of the emerging frontiers of machine learning, aiming to integrate federated learning within the fine-tuning pipelines of vision-language models (VLMs). In this work, we introduce BLEND, a new framework designed to jointly enhance the personalization and generalization capabilities of FedVLMs. BLEND proposes a selective VLM parameter fine-tuning and aggregation strategy that consists of (i) global vision and text adapters shared across clients, and (ii) a personalized vision projection adapter tailored to each client. BLEND further introduces a novel loss function that blends the outputs of the global and personalized adapters to achieve personalization, while simultaneously promoting generalization through a principled anchor design implemented via the projection heads of the zero-shot VLM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BLEND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting its ability to effectively balance personalization and generalization across diverse system settings. (Code is available at: https://github.com/payamsiabd/BLEND.git)

papers.title_en: ShoreKeeper: Accelerating Iterative Data Analytics in the Cloud via Distributed Recovery-Cost-Aware Caching
papers.authors: Jongseop Lee, Minsu Sun, Xinyue Ma, Atul Sandur, Myeongjae Jeon
papers.evidence: 面向迭代机器学习负载的集群缓存基础设施
papers.tldr: 迭代式图计算与机器学习会持续产生中间数据，现有节点本地缓存难以适应全局内存压力和云节点波动。ShoreKeeper将集群内存视为统一弹性资源池，把分布式数据流映射为全局图优化缓存放置。它以最小化跨节点缓存驱逐后的数据恢复代价为目标，并用图剪枝快速应对工作集和容量变化。实验表明，该框架在高可用虚拟机及可抢占实例上均稳定优于现有系统。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale data-intensive workloads powered by iterative graph or machine learning processing have an insatiable demand for memory due to the continuous generation of new intermediate data. Although existing caching strategies strive to keep performance-critical data in memory, they often fail in practice because they are limited to node-local memory management and assume high node availability. In this paper, we introduce ShoreKeeper, a framework that maximizes execution efficiency by treating cluster-wide memory as a unified, elastic pool. ShoreKeeper employs a global optimization model that maps distributed dataflows into a single graph abstraction to minimize the recovery cost of data evicted from cache across the cluster. To handle memory working sets and cluster capacities that fluctuate over time, ShoreKeeper employs a graph-pruning technique that permits the fast refinement of the caching plan. These optimizations allow ShoreKeeper to work seamlessly whether deployed on highly available VMs or cost-effective preemptible instances in the cloud. Our experiments show that ShoreKeeper consistently outperforms state-of-the-art systems.

papers.title_en: Private and Distributionally Robust Federated Multiclass Classification
papers.authors: Andrea P. Hernandez, Michael Ibrahim, Nagi Gebraeel
papers.evidence: 隐私保护且鲁棒的联邦训练框架
papers.tldr: 面向多站点工业故障诊断，联邦多分类模型虽能避免集中数据，却常缺少记录级隐私保障，并易受标签噪声影响。论文将 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒优化与 Crammer-Singer 多分类损失结合，采用 ADMM 联邦求解。其在客户端本地模型及鲁棒变量更新中注入校准高斯噪声，并用矩会计量化跨轮隐私损失。实验显示，该方法在多数场景优于差分隐私联邦经验风险最小化和随机梯度下降，尤其在强隐私噪声下优势显著。
papers.abstract_en: Fault diagnosis in asset-intensive industries requires multiclass models trained on noisy, sensitive data collected across geographically distributed client sites. Federated learning enables collaborative training without centralizing data, but most approaches do not provide formal privacy guarantees for individual records stored at client sites and can degrade under label noise. To address these limitations, we develop a differentially private, distributionally robust framework for federated multiclass classification that provides sample-level privacy for records stored at each client. We build on a federated Wasserstein distributionally robust multiclass objective with the Crammer-Singer loss, solved using an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm. To protect the released client updates, our method injects calibrated Gaussian noise into the proximal linearized client updates of both the local model and the local distributionally robust variable before aggregation at the central server, and we quantify the cumulative privacy loss using the moments accountant. We provide per-round sample-level $(ε,δ)$-differential privacy guarantees and an overall composed privacy guarantee across all training rounds, together with convergence results and an explicit privacy-utility tradeoff. Experiments on simulated industrial fault data and UCI benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms differentially private federated empirical risk minimization and stochastic gradient descent baselines in most tested settings, with the largest gains under strong privacy-induced noise.

papers.title_en: On the Depth Transfer of Neural Optimizers via L-Smoothness
papers.authors: Maximilian Wong, Chenyu Xu, Jiajin Li, Yiping Lu
papers.evidence: 面向大规模训练的超参数迁移
papers.tldr: 大模型扩展需要低成本代理深度上的学习率等超参数可预测地迁移，但现有理论常依赖特定架构、初始化和无限深度假设。本文以损失的Lipschitz与L-光滑常数刻画深度迁移，对任意残差分支及p→q几何证明采用α=Θ(1/K)的逆深度缩放，即可使两类常数在固定宽度下与深度无关。该结论无需层间权重相关性假设，并导出无需额外深度曲率修正的学习率尺度。在GPT-2与CIFAR-100 ResNet实验中，Muon、MOGA跨最高64倍深度保持共同最优学习率，为优化器和残差网络的稳健扩展提供几何依据。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling deep learning models efficiently requires predictable performance transfer across compute regimes. Establishing reliable hyperparameter transfer allows optimal training dynamics and structural choices to be discovered on low-cost proxy models, avoiding catastrophic failures during massive-scale training. Existing depth-transfer analyses are architecture-specific and heuristic: hyperparameter transfer is only justified through toy blocks, and both rely on infinite-depth dynamics, a specific initialization, and feature-learning criteria. Building on $L$-smoothness framework of Xu et al. (2026), we understand hyperparameter transfer as how do the Lipschitz and $L$-smoothness constants of the loss scale with the depth $K$? We show that inverse-depth residual branch scaling $α=Θ(1/K)$ is sufficient to make both constants depth-independent at fixed width, uniformly over the bounded parameter domain and for arbitrary $p\to q$ geometries. Because the bounds depend on each residual branch only through its Lipschitz and smoothness constants, the argument applies to general residual networks (including branches of block depth $\geq 2$ such as transformer and ResNet blocks) without assumptions on initialization or correlations between layer weights. Since the smoothness constant controls the curvature penalty in the descent inequality, our bounds motivate a learning-rate scale without an additional depth-dependent curvature correction for updates bounded in the prescribed norm. This provides a geometric explanation of inverse-depth residual scaling and its application to the operator-norm geometries associated with AdamW, Muon, and MOGA. Learning-rate sweeps on GPT-2 (depths 2--128) and CIFAR-100 ResNets (8--32 residual blocks) confirm that Muon and MOGA exhibit stable learning-rate transfer under these prescriptions, with a common optimal rate across a 64-fold increase in depth.

papers.title_en: Heterogeneous Structured Pruning Under Resource Constraints for Hardware-Efficient Large Language Models
papers.authors: Cameron Barker, Andreas Paraskeva, Jan N. van Rijn, Elliot J. Crowley, Henry Gouk
papers.evidence: 面向时延和内存约束的硬件感知大模型压缩
papers.tldr: 4、块稀疏及头/通道剪枝的异构候选空间，并以时延和内存模型施加资源约束。全局求解器为每个子层联合选择结构与密度，以最小化代理剪枝损失。在Jetson Orin Nano上的OPT和LLaMA实验表明，其质量—资源前沿优于现有免训练基线。
papers.abstract_en: Training-free pruning removes weights from pretrained large language models to reduce their deployment cost. However, existing approaches typically consider only the total number of retained weights. Consequently, their pruning decisions do not account for how target hardware stores and processes those weights. These methods select a sparsity structure in advance and apply it uniformly to all projections, rather than accounting for how each structure trades pruning error against latency and memory across sublayers. We propose Heterogeneous Structured Pruning (HSP), a hardware-aware pruning framework that combines two components: (i) a heterogeneous search space of dense, unstructured, 2:4, block-sparse, and head / channel (H/C) pruning options and (ii) structure-regularising constraints based on latency and memory models. Our contribution generalises existing importance-based methods: a global solver selects one option per sublayer to minimise proxy pruning loss under a resource budget, thereby assigning each projection a structure and density. We evaluate HSP on OPT and LLaMA models for an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super edge device, where it improves the quality-resource frontiers over training-free baselines.   A project page and updated links for the related code is maintained at: cameronbarker.me/publications/hsp.

papers.title_en: EDiS: Edge Disjoint Subgraph Sparsification Framework for Graph Neural Networks
papers.authors: Sai Karthik Navuluru, Siddhartha Shankar Das, Franck Dernoncourt, S M Ferdous, Ryan A. Rossi, Nesreen K. Ahmed, Baris Coskunuzer, Alex Pothen, Lakshman Tamil, Mahantesh M Halappanavar
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏图神经网络训练的计算优化机制
papers.tldr: 稀疏GNN训练虽能降低计算量，但固定稀疏图会限制拓扑多样性，而逐轮重新采样或筛边代价高。EDiS先一次性将原图分解为可缓存的边不相交子图，再按边预算和保留率跨轮重组训练图。其默认覆盖森林分解可保留高分割边，并给出重组后的条件存活界。在19个节点分类基准、相同边预算下，EDiS取得最高平均分、最低平均排名和最小最优差距。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse GNN training reduces computation, but deciding which edges to keep can be costly. Reusing one sparse graph is cheap, but locks training to a fixed topology, while varying it across epochs can require repeated sampling or recomputation. We introduce EDiS (Edge-Disjoint Subgraph sparsification framework), which separates one-time structural extraction from per-epoch graph composition. EDiS decomposes the graph once into cacheable edge-disjoint subgraphs, then recombines them into graphs with edge-budget constraints across epochs and retention ratios without re-extracting structure. Our default construction uses feature-based scores and successive maximum score covering forests, while the same composition mechanism also supports alternative edge selection rules. We provide a combinatorial analysis of the per-epoch sampler, the composition step that draws a training graph from the cached decomposition. We show that, under the default covering-forest selector, the stored decomposition deterministically preserves high-score cut edges, and we derive a selector-agnostic conditional bound on high-score cut survival in composed training graphs. Across 19 homophilic, heterophilic, and large-scale node classification benchmarks against 17 baselines under the same edge budget, EDiS achieves the highest mean benchmark score (accuracy/ROC-AUC) and the lowest average rank and gap-to-best among ranked methods. Ablations show the clearest benefits of structural decomposition and epoch variation at tight edge budgets.

papers.title_en: Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization for Data-free Mixture-of-Experts Compression
papers.authors: Tianxiao Cao, Jiahe Shao, Yuning Qiu, Kyohei Atarashi, Hisashi Kashima, Qibin Zhao
papers.evidence: MoE压缩降低大模型存储与服务开销
papers.tldr: 稀疏路由的MoE虽能将模型容量与计算量解耦，但海量专家参数仍带来显著存储和部署负担。论文分析剪枝、合并与权重重构三类压缩路线，指出前两者会因路由变化和专家异质性产生难以消除的结构误差。为此提出无数据的共享低秩基分解SLBF，以专家共享的秩k基重构权重，并通过后验规范固定消除冗余参数。在16B至122B的五种MoE架构上，该方法稳定优于三类压缩方法，证明保留专家结构和路由的重构范式更适合MoE压缩。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models decouple capacity from compute through sparse routing, but their large parameter count creates storage and serving challenges. We analyze three MoE compression families: expert pruning, expert merging, and weight reconstruction, and derive structural error bounds showing that pruning and merging can incur non-vanishing errors tied to routing and expert heterogeneity. In contrast, weight reconstruction avoids these structural costs by preserving expert structure and routing. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization (SLBF), a data-free weight reconstruction method that uses rank-$k$ bases shared among experts, enabling richer cross-expert sharing, faster convergence, and lower reconstruction error. A post-hoc gauge fixing removes redundant parameters at no representational cost. Across five MoE architectures spanning 16B to 122B parameters, SLBF consistently outperforms methods from all three compression families.

papers.title_en: AutoAdapt: Automatic Domain Discovery Enables Low-Cost Extensibility
papers.authors: Josh McGiff, Salma Mekaoui, Robert Shanahan, Nikola S. Nikolov
papers.evidence: 面向演化式大模型部署的模块化并行适配器训练与路由
papers.tldr: 指令微调模型面对不断新增、彼此异质的领域时，传统做法往往需要汇总数据并进行昂贵再训练，且易产生领域干扰。AutoAdapt先自动发现潜在领域，再为每个领域并行训练独立的低秩适配器，并以免参数路由选择适配器。其在14个领域基准及GPT-4o成对评测中，性能可媲美单个全域适配器。该框架无需预设分类体系或更新既有适配器，为低成本、模块化持续扩展提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-tuned models are deployed into environments where domains are heterogeneous and evolve, yet adding new domains or data typically requires costly retraining. We present AutoAdapt, a modular framework that incorporates new domains and data via targeted single-adapter training without modifying other adapters. The framework automatically discovers latent domains, uses them to train per-domain Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters independently in parallel and performs parameter-free routing. Across 14 domain-specific benchmarks and GPT-4o pairwise judgements, AutoAdapt achieves parity with a LoRA adapter trained on all domains without requiring full-model retraining. We also find evidence of specialisation effect convergence across independent discovery methods. Overall, training each adapter on its own domain prevents domain interference by construction, thus enabling modular, taxonomy-free domain specialisation without aggregate performance loss or full model retraining.
